# Fynx CV writer

Fynx CV is a client-side CV and cover-letter editor at https://cv-editor.fynx.io.vn/. It renders PDF, DOCX and HTML; user data stays in the browser. The AI writes content, and the app renders it.

## Main skill

Download https://cv-editor.fynx.io.vn/fynx-cv-writer-skill.zip for `cv-writer` plus optional domain skills. `cv-slop-review` is separate and runs only when the user requests a quality/ATS/slop review.

- Content contract: https://cv-editor.fynx.io.vn/ai/schema.json
- Format config contract: https://cv-editor.fynx.io.vn/ai/config.schema.json
- Writing guidance: https://cv-editor.fynx.io.vn/ai/cv-writing-rules.md

## Two JSON files

`content.json` contains `cv`, optional `coverLetter`, and `layout` (section order, hidden sections, headings). The CV can include `title`, `projectIntro`, projects with `overview`, `dates`/`technologies`, and any number of `customSections` whose entries use the experience layout. Projects support substantial employer systems as a complement to Experience; describe the actual product/domain/users/scope and keep the candidate's role in contribution bullets.

`config.json` contains only `template`, `language`, `sizeMultiplier`, `selectedFont`, `customFontName`, `experienceHeaderStyle`, `bulletChars`, and `avatarStyle`. It is optional. The CLI uses its built-in default unless a complete config file is passed; a supplied file replaces the entire default. It must not contain layout.

## Handoff

Paste `content.json` into the editor, or use `fynx-cv.mjs link content.json [--config config.json]` / **More → Copy share link** for a short preview URL. Short links store the CV in the Share Worker for three days; anyone with the link can view it during that time. If the Worker is unavailable, the tool may return a compressed offline URL.

`window.cvEditor.load(bundle)` and `window.cvEditor.shareLink()` are available to browser agents. Agents with a shell should use `fynx-cv.mjs validate|create|link|audit content.json [--config config.json]`; `audit` is optional, heuristic, and now checks project descriptions and ordering. Chat agents without code execution should import the JSON in the editor and use its share control, or output the JSON for the user to import. Do not construct long JSON URLs or claim a PDF was rendered unless the renderer ran.
